school.zh: 墨尔本大学（The University of Melbourne）

degree.zh: 商学学士（Bachelor of Commerce），2024–2027，在读

items.en: A push notification pipeline on public data: two-tower recall with a faiss index, coarse and LightGBM fine ranking, uplift models, and a delivery policy for send, time slot and copy.
items.zh: 基于公开数据的推送推荐管线：双塔召回配 faiss 索引，粗排加 LightGBM 精排，增益模型，以及决定发不发、何时发、发什么文案的投放策略。

items.en: Off-policy evaluation (IPS, DR) checked against a known answer on the Open Bandit Dataset; on the full campaign no estimator passed with the registered intervals over impressions, so the project reports no result that rests on one. Post hoc, over ten-minute blocks, the intervals of both contain the known value, and the registered verdict stands.
items.zh: 离策略评估（IPS、DR）先在 Open Bandit 数据集上对照已知答案检验；在完整活动数据上，按登记的曝光重采样区间没有估计器通过，因此项目不报告依赖它的结果。事后按 10 分钟时间块重采样，两者的区间都包含已知值，登记的判定不变。

items.en: A simulator fitted on KuaiRand random exposures for effects no public dataset records, with results labelled by evidence tier (A real data, B checked estimator, C simulator only).
items.zh: 公开数据集没有记录的效应，用在 KuaiRand 随机曝光上拟合的模拟器估计；每个结果按证据等级标注（A 真实数据，B 经检验的估计器，C 仅在模拟器中成立）。

items.en: Comparisons registered before the simulations and reported as they came out, including a pre-registered ranking result that went the other way.
items.zh: 比较方案在模拟之前预注册，结果原样报告，包括一个与预期方向相反的预注册排序结果。

items.en: A pre-registered recheck of the Open Bandit benchmark: propositions, statistics and decision rules committed before any outcome of the confirmatory campaigns was computed, with one campaign to develop on and two for the verdicts.
items.zh: 对 Open Bandit 基准的预注册复核：命题、统计量和判定规则在两个确认性活动的任何结果算出之前提交，一个活动用来开发，两个活动用于判定。

items.en: On the two confirmatory campaigns the published prior is not the distribution the BTS log shows (distance 0.53 against a noise floor of 0.11 to 0.14), and the IPS estimate pooled over them is 0.974 of the on-policy click rate (0.915 to 1.036 over ten-minute blocks): no shortfall is shown, and one of up to 8.5% is not excluded.
items.zh: 在两个确认性活动上，公开的先验与 BTS 日志实际展示的分布不一致（距离 0.53，噪声底 0.11 到 0.14）；合并的 IPS 估计是在线点击率的 0.974（按 10 分钟时间块，区间 0.915 到 1.036）：没有显示出偏低，最多 8.5% 的偏低也排除不了。

items.en: Post hoc, on all three campaigns: the standard deviation of that ratio with ten-minute blocks as resampling units is 1.31 to 1.47 times the one with rows or impressions.
items.zh: 事后分析，三个活动都是如此：按 10 分钟时间块重采样时，这个比值的标准差是按行或按曝光重采样时的 1.31 到 1.47 倍。

items.en: BM25 retrieval in Go, with Lucene's scoring computed from a Bleve index: on six BEIR test sets its nDCG@10 and Recall@100 equal Pyserini's published BM25 numbers to all four decimals, and the run files reproduce byte for byte from committed checksums.
items.zh: 用 Go 实现的 BM25 检索，在 Bleve 的索引上按 Lucene 的公式打分：在六个 BEIR 测试集上，nDCG@10 和 Recall@100 与 Pyserini 公布的 BM25 数字四位小数全部一致，结果文件可以按已提交的校验和逐字节复现。

items.en: Dense retrieval with BGE-base-en-v1.5 on ONNX Runtime and exact search: on six BEIR test sets its nDCG@10 is within 0.0006 of Pyserini's, and within 0.0004 on all but TREC-COVID. Comparing every document vector of SciFact and ArguAna with Pyserini's found 28 documents below a cosine of 0.9999, each holding Unicode format characters that Pyserini's tokenizer removes and the Go library kept.
items.zh: 稠密检索用 ONNX Runtime 上的 BGE-base-en-v1.5 加精确搜索：在六个 BEIR 测试集上，nDCG@10 与 Pyserini 的相差不超过 0.0006，除 TREC-COVID 外不超过 0.0004。把 SciFact 和 ArguAna 每篇文档的向量与 Pyserini 的逐一比较，查出 28 篇余弦低于 0.9999，每一篇都含有 Unicode 格式字符：Pyserini 的分词器会删掉它们，Go 的分词库没有删。

items.en: A recommendation serving system in Go: retrieval, features, ranking and rerank behind one HTTP API, with the user encoder and the ranker run through ONNX Runtime.
items.zh: 用 Go 写的推荐服务系统：召回、特征、排序和重排在同一个 HTTP 接口后面，用户编码器和排序模型通过 ONNX Runtime 运行。

items.en: Item vectors split into shards on replicas over gRPC: a search goes to the next replica when one fails and to a second when the first is slow, at most one hedge per search. With one replica of every shard lost, every response equals the one with all replicas healthy; for a replica that goes silent, this holds within the hedge budget.
items.zh: 物品向量分片后放在 gRPC 副本上：一个副本失败时查询立刻转到下一个，第一个慢时再发给第二个，每次查询最多一次对冲。每个分片各丢一个副本时，每个响应都与副本全部正常时相同；副本不应答的那种情况，在对冲预算之内成立。

items.en: Model bundles swapped while serving: every replica prepares the new version, activation is atomic, and a version is the digest of its files, checked by the gateway and by every replica.
items.zh: 模型包在服务期间替换：每个副本先备好新版本，切换是原子的；版本号是包内文件的摘要，网关和每个副本都校验。

items.en: Events through Kafka to an ingest consumer that applies them idempotently; user histories and the result cache on Valkey, with a circuit breaker that keeps the gateway answering while Valkey is down.
items.zh: 事件经 Kafka 进入幂等的消费程序；用户历史和结果缓存放在 Valkey，Valkey 不可用时由熔断器保证网关继续应答。

items.en: Deployed in kind: replicas as a StatefulSet, gateways with an HPA, Pod Security `restricted`, and a NetworkPolicy whose enforcement CI checks. At 100 requests/s, through rolling restarts of the gateways and of the replicas and a bundle swap, no response failed or was degraded, with stage budgets of 100 ms on one node.
items.zh: 部署在 kind 上：副本用 StatefulSet，网关带 HPA，命名空间执行 Pod Security `restricted`，NetworkPolicy 是否生效由 CI 检查。每秒 100 个请求下，网关滚动重启、副本滚动重启和一次换包期间，没有一个响应失败或降级；单节点，各阶段的时间预算为 100 ms。

items.en: Users split between A/B arms by a hash of the experiment's name and the user ID, with an exposure log; rate and in-flight limits that answer 503 at once; OpenTelemetry traces from the gateway's API through each stage to the replicas' searches.
items.zh: 按实验名和用户 ID 的哈希把用户分到 A/B 实验组，并写曝光日志；速率和在途请求数超限时立刻回 503；OpenTelemetry 追踪从网关的接口经每个阶段一直到副本上的搜索。

items.en: A logistic-regression ranker over six features, whose bundle carries golden features that the gateway recomputes at load. On 680 held-out users its recall@10 is 0.091 against 0.026 for retrieval order, measured before MMR, and its weight on the vector score is negative.
items.zh: 六个特征上的逻辑回归排序模型，模型包带着黄金特征，网关加载时重算核对。在 680 个留出用户上，它的 recall@10 是 0.091，召回顺序是 0.026，在 MMR 之前测得；它给向量分的权重是负的。

items.en: A CPU profile at 400 requests/s put 54% of a replica's CPU in the inner product of exact search. Rewritten in AVX2 with a fixed order of additions, it takes 4.5 to 5 times less time, and p99 at 400 requests/s fell from 6.90–7.79 ms to 4.27–4.64 ms; at that rate the gateway's CPU per request is not resolved on this machine.
items.zh: 每秒 400 个请求下的 CPU 剖析显示，副本 54% 的 CPU 花在精确搜索的内积上。改用 AVX2 并固定加法顺序后，内积的速度是原来的 4.5 到 5 倍，每秒 400 个请求时的 p99 从 6.90–7.79 ms 降到 4.27–4.64 ms；这个速率下网关每个请求的 CPU 时间在这台机器上分辨不了。

items.en: Limit order book matching engine in Go: price-time priority, REST and WebSocket APIs, a bounded queue per symbol; new orders and cancels get 503 when it is full.
items.zh: 用 Go 写的限价订单簿撮合引擎：价格优先、时间优先，提供 REST 和 WebSocket 接口；每个交易对一个有界队列，队列满时下单和撤单直接返回 503。

items.en: Durability by a write-ahead command log, fsynced every 10 ms on a background goroutine, with a crash test that kills the engine under load.
items.zh: 持久化靠预写命令日志，由后台 goroutine 每 10 ms fsync 一次；崩溃测试在压测中途杀掉引擎进程。

items.en: Price levels in a red-black tree chosen by benchmark over a skip list and a sorted slice (250 ns against 405 ns at 10,000 levels).
items.zh: 价位用红黑树，经基准测试与跳表、有序切片比较后选定（1 万个价位时 250 ns 对 405 ns）。

items.en: Open-loop load generation with scheduled send times, so a stalled server is charged the delay; a run counts only if every trade reaches the client once and in order, checked by sequence numbers and 64-bit hash sums.
items.zh: 开环压测按计划时间发请求，服务端卡顿的时间会计入延迟；只有每笔成交都按序、恰好一次送达客户端，这次运行才算数，用序号和 64 位哈希和核对。

items.en: CPU profiling that moved the work away from the book: a JSON key check from 5.79 µs and 79 allocations to 0.51 µs and none.
items.zh: CPU 剖析把优化的重点从订单簿移开：JSON 键检查从 5.79 µs、79 次内存分配降到 0.51 µs、零分配。

body.en: Go, Python, TypeScript. gRPC, Kafka, Valkey, ONNX Runtime, Kubernetes, Prometheus, OpenTelemetry. React, FastAPI, Electron. SQLite, SQLCipher 4 format, DuckDB, Parquet. Web Crypto, Argon2id. LightGBM, faiss, NumPy, Bleve. GitHub Actions. This site: Astro and hand-written WebGL2 and GLSL.
body.zh: Go、Python、TypeScript。gRPC、Kafka、Valkey、ONNX Runtime、Kubernetes、Prometheus、OpenTelemetry。React、FastAPI、Electron。SQLite、SQLCipher 4 格式、DuckDB、Parquet。Web Crypto、Argon2id。LightGBM、faiss、NumPy、Bleve。GitHub Actions。本站：Astro，以及手写的 WebGL2 和 GLSL。

body.en: My work is algorithm engineering and server-side systems, with backend development next to them. On the algorithm side: recommendation models and off-policy evaluation, where comparisons are registered before the results and reported as they came out, including a ranking result that went the other way and a benchmark shortfall that the confirmatory campaigns did not show; and retrieval, where each component is accepted against a published number. On the server side: a recommendation serving system checked under load through rolling restarts and a bundle swap. Every number on this site traces back to a project repository.
body.zh: 我的方向是算法工程和服务端系统，其次是后端开发。算法方面做推荐模型和离策略评估：比较方案在出结果之前登记，结果原样报告，包括一个方向与预期相反的排序结果，和一个在确认性活动上没有显示出来的基准偏低；也做检索，每个组件都对照已公布的数字验收。服务端方面做了一个推荐服务系统，在持续请求下经过了滚动重启和换包的检验。站上的每个数字都能追溯到项目仓库。
